environment: Injected JavaScript fixtures and deterministic clock; no Minecraft bridge or screenshots

workload.fixture: Two projected views of the same client read, 9 inventory slots with bulky components, one redstone output block

cases.name: compact_every_poll
cases.observation_semantics: All watches read each poll; identical requests share one observation. Separate requests are not atomic.

cases.name: compact_with_no_change_backoff
cases.observation_semantics: Fewer fresh observations; explicit deferred responses report their age. Does not provide equal temporal coverage to raw polling.

limitations: UTF-8 JSON payload bytes only; not measured model tokens, monetary cost or live performance.
Inventory component omission and selected fields intentionally deliver less detail than raw readings.
Payload sizes and savings depend on real bridge output and chosen fields.
Backoff can delay change detection and cannot capture transient redstone pulses.
